exposure: salivary gland tumors diagnosed during pregnancy
outcome: diagnostic approaches for SGTs during pregnancy
treatment strategies for SGTs during pregnancy
disease progression of SGTs during pregnancy
cohort: The cohort consisted of six women diagnosed with salivary gland tumors during pregnancy, identified from a larger database of women of reproductive age with SGTs.
finding: Benign salivary gland tumors diagnosed during pregnancy were typically monitored and surgically treated postpartum, while malignant tumors required more immediate or postpartum intervention depending on progression.
